title: 第三章：大采购
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

苏行枫离开药店时都过了十二点了，这会儿他也肚子饿了，找了一家快餐店吃饱后，来到街边打了一辆的士来到一家户外用品店。

这店内的品种很多，规格也很高，因为苏行枫当过兵，所以知道哪些品牌和哪些东西好用好使，所以他没有等服务的介绍，自己就拉了一辆购物车自己在那慢慢的挑选了起来，到最后不知不觉中就推了两辆购物车了，来到收银台前。

“你好先生这是要结帐吗？”一个女服务员看到他选了这么多东西很是开心。

“是的，麻烦你帮我看一下多少钱”

“好的，请你稍等一下”

滴~滴~滴~滴~滴~滴~~~

在扫码枪一声声滴滴扫描下，过了十几分钟后价格算是出来了。

“先生，你选购的物品一共是176.65万元，鉴于先生在我店购买金额量大，先生可以成为我们店的钻石会员，可享8折优惠，还可以抽三次奖哦！”

“哦，好的，抽奖是抽什么啊？”苏行枫听到抽奖来了兴趣。

“先生，你看那边，就是那单兵坦克DTVShredder全地形平衡车”女服务员指了指那台车说。

“这个好，嘿嘿！那你给我先结帐吧，一会儿抽抽试试”他一看那车脑袋里一想，自己去那边交通工具也要装备一下的，这正好有抽奖的机会不抽白不抽啊！

等这边刷卡交完钱，他跟着那服务员来到一个抽奖箱前。

“先生，你有三次机会，你可以一次次抽，也可以一次抽三张......”

在服务员一阵解说后，他一下就从抽奖箱中抓了三张奖票出来，然后一张张的刮开，前面两张都没奖，到了最后一张刮开了一个半价奖，也就是只出一半的价格就可以买到那车了。原价4.5万现在苏行枫再出个2.25万就可以到手了。之后他还让店里的工作人员帮他改装了一下，加大了单兵坦克的电池容量用了5千。

然后他又买了一辆全地形四轮越野花了165万，该买的装备现在都齐全了，他让店里的人明天送到自己家就行了，还好的是自己在这买了这么多东西花了这么大一笔钱，店里也乐意送。

接下来苏行枫要准备的是食物，他不知道那边的什么情况，至少在没有能力的情况下多准备一下是好的，速食类东西，还有就是连煤气罐和锅他都准备好了，只差一个厨房了，反正他想戒子空间有这么大，两个字‘不怕’见到有可能用得上的就是一个字‘买’，就光是米他就买了一顿。

除了吃还有战斗类用具，这些东西户外店里有是有，但是都是一些小东西，可是他见到的那条大蛇后他知道，就光那些小刀小棍的绝对是没用的，所以一定是要有一些热武器才可以。他以前是特种兵出生，有自己的购货渠道，所以他拿出自己的手机拨手打了一个电话。

“Hello”

他当兵时在国外执行过很多任务，所以他能流利的用英文和他人交流，这会儿他打的是在俄罗国那边的一个地下军火商。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

It was past twelve o'clock when Su Xingfeng left the pharmacy. He was also hungry at this time. After finding a fast food restaurant to eat, he went to the street and took a taxi to an outdoor goods store.

There are many varieties in this store, and the specifications are also very high. Because Su Xingfeng served in the military, he knows which brands and which items are easy to use. So without waiting for the introduction of the service, he pulled a shopping cart and slowly picked it up. In the end, he unknowingly pushed two shopping carts and came to the checkout counter.

"Hello sir, do you want to pay?" A waitress was very happy to see that he had chosen so many things.

"Yes, please help me see how much it costs."

"Okay, please wait a moment."

Di~di~di~di~di~di~~~

Under the beep beep of the code scanner, the price came out after more than ten minutes.

"Sir, the total amount of items you purchased is 1,766,500 yuan. In view of the large amount of your purchase in our store, you can become a diamond member of our store and enjoy a 20% discount, and you can also draw three prizes!"

"Oh, okay, what is the draw for?" Su Xingfeng became interested when he heard about the draw.

"Sir, look over there, that's the DTVShredder all-terrain balancing vehicle, the individual tank." The waitress pointed at the vehicle and said.

"That's good, hehe! Then you pay me the bill first and try to draw one later." When he looked at the car, he thought, he also needs to equip himself with transportation to go there. This is a chance to draw a lottery. If you don't draw, you won't get it!

After swiping the card and paying the money, he followed the waiter to a lottery box.

"Sir, you have three chances. You can draw one card at a time, or you can draw three cards at once..."

After the waiter explained for a while, he immediately grabbed three prize tickets from the lottery box, and then scratched them open one by one. The first two did not win any prizes, and the last one scratched off a half-price prize, which meant that you could buy the car for only half the price.The original price was 45,000, and now Su Xingfeng can get it for another 22,500.Later, he asked the store staff to help him modify it and increase the battery capacity of the individual tank by 5,000 yuan.

Then he bought another all-terrain four-wheel off-road vehicle for 1.65 million. All the equipment he needed to buy is now complete. He just asked the people in the store to deliver it to his home tomorrow. Fortunately, he bought so many things here and spent such a large sum of money, and the store was willing to deliver them.

The next thing Su Xingfeng had to prepare was food. He didn't know what was going on over there, so at least it would be good to prepare more if he didn't have the ability. He had already prepared instant food, as well as gas tanks and pots. There was only one kitchen left. Anyway, he wanted to have such a big space, so the two words "not afraid" and the word "buy" when he saw something that might be useful, he bought a meal with just rice.

In addition to food, there are also fighting tools. These things are available in outdoor stores, but they are all small things. But after he saw the big snake, he knew that just those small knives and sticks were absolutely useless, so he must have some hot weapons.He was a former special soldier and had his own purchasing channels, so he took out his mobile phone and made a call.

"Hello"

He had performed many missions abroad when he was a soldier, so he could communicate with others fluently in English. At this time, he was fighting an underground arms dealer in Russia.
